name: Mistral AI
short: Direct API access to Mistral's open-weight and commercial models, plus the Vibe assistant and coding plans.

plans.name: Free mode (API)
plans.notes: API keys with no credit card required; conservative RPS/token limits for evaluation and prototyping.

plans.name: API pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Mistral Large $0.50 input / $1.50 output; Batch is 50% cheaper and cached input up to 90% off.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Limited messages, web searches, and coding sessions in Vibe; basic image generation.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Full Vibe access, all-day coding, and $15/month in API credits; verified students pay $5.99.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Shared workspace with higher limits, up to 30 GB storage per user, domain verification, and data export.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Private deployment with custom models, agents, and workflows; audit logs, SAML SSO, white label.
